EXECUTIONVERSION ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement") made as of Noyember fn thisdayofOctobe STATE OF NEW YORK, acting by and through the COMMISSIONER of the OFFICE of GENERAL SERVICES, whose principal place of business is 36th Floor, Corning Tower, Empire State Plaza, Albany, NY 12242 ("State"), and 1 JAVA OWNER LLC, having an address at c/o Lendlease Americas Inc., 200 Park Avenue, 9th Floor, New York, New York 10166 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Developer is the owner in fee title of certain lands, including lands under water, comprising portions of the parcels identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") as Block 2538, Lot 1 and Block 2530, Lot 20, as more particularly called herein the “Developer's Land"; said lands, buildings and improvements thereon, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto, and any new Building constructed Developer's Property located landward of the Bulkhead Line (hereinafter defined), “Developer's LandwardProperty").  B. State is the owner of certain lands underwater comprising the portions of the Subject Property other than the Developer's Land, as illustrated on the Survey (hereinafter defined) including portions of lands underwater occupied by the India Street Pier (hereinafter defined), as more particularly described in Exhibit D annexed hereto (said land, the “State's Land"). C. The Developer's Land and the State's Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance of at least 10 linear feet and are proposed to be combined to be a single “zoning lot” under subdivision (d) of such definition as set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined). D.  Developer has previously developed, at Developer's sole cost and expense, a pier extending from the seaward end of India Street, including over a portion of the State's Land, as US\22361647.v10 139

shown on the Survey (the existing pier and any replacement or reconfiguration thereof, “India Street Pier").  E. The India Street Pier qualifies as an “existing pier” within the meaning of Section 62-11 of the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined). F. Under the Zoning Resolution, the Pier Development Rights (hereinafter defined) exist solely as aresult of the construction of theIndiaStreet Pier by Developer andwould not exist if the India Street Pier were not constructed by Developer, and none of the Pier Development Rights are now being utilized.        s       Resolution, the Pier Development Rights may be utilized on lands landward of the Bulkhead Line in accordance with and subject to the requirements of the Zoning Resolution. H.  In furtherance of the development of Developer's Property, Developer desires to utilize the Pier Development Rights on Developer's Landward Property for the benefit of Developer's Property, and State desires to affirm and agree that the Pier Development Rights may be utilized by Developer on Developer's Landward Property.  1. To achieve these objectives, State and Developer are executing a Declaration of Januay18,2022 Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated as of tre-date hereof (the "Declaration"), a copy of which is annexed hereto as Exhibit C, confirming that the Developer's Land and the State's Land are a single “zoning lot" (the “Combined Zoning Lot") under subdivision (d) of such definition as set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined), and simultaneously wish to enter into this Agreement for the purpose of establishing and setting forth the rights and obligations of the Parties (hereinafter defined) with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, intending to be legally bound, and in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: ARTICLEI DEFINITIONS;DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS 2 140
